title: pyrus malus subsp. pumila
intro: Pyrus malus subsp. pumila, commonly known as dwarf wild apple or crab apple, is a subspecies of apple tree known for its small fruit and hardy growth habits. This plant is rich in antioxidants and has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Pyrus malus subsp. pumila include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents of this plant also exhibit potential therapeutic properties, including hepatoprotective, neuroprotective, and anti-cancer effects.
